title: Bound verification repair loops to a fixed number of attempts
narrative: After a failed verification, Fangore allows a limited repair-and-retry cycle. When attempts are exhausted, the node stays failed — it does not loop forever. Complements `fangore_convergence_ceiling` for judge loops and `fangore_insp_verification_gate` for completion versus answer-generated. See inspiration requirements for verification loops[^insp-repair].

footnotes.label: Inspiration requirements (verification loops)
footnotes.note: Req 5 — verification is part of execution; structured enough to route repair
